items.title: Flatness and faithful flatness are preserved by base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if M is flat, respectively faithfully flat, over R and R to R' is a ring map, then the base change M tensor R' is flat, respectively faithfully flat, over R' (statement lines 9105-9109). The proof does not chase exact sequences: it observes that for every R'-module N the module N tensor over R' with R' tensor M is canonically N tensor over R with M, so exactness of the base changed functor is exactly the exactness of the original one, faithful flatness following from the same identification (proof lines 9111-9117). The canonical isomorphism carrying the whole statement is the content, and the author writes it down. H2.
